scripts.build: npm run content:build && npm run build:app -- --local-media
scripts.test: node --import remix/node-tsx --test tests/*.test.ts app/document-host/*.test.ts app/newsletter/*.test.ts && playwright test
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test:website: node --import remix/node-tsx --test app/newsletter/*.test.ts app/document-host/*.test.ts && playwright test --config playwright.website.config.ts
scripts.check:website: prettier app contracts scripts/publishing scripts/build.ts scripts/build-dev.ts scripts/check-content-host.ts playwright*.config.ts tests/website.spec.ts tests/host-fixture.ts tests/website-worker.ts cmx.config.ts tsconfig.website.json package.json wrangler.jsonc .github/workflows/deploy.yml --check && npm run typecheck:website && npm run test:website
